name: Fujiwara no Tadahira
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 26); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. c. 936.

poems.title: The maples of Mount Ogura
poems.author: Fujiwara no Tadahira
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 26
poems.text:
The maples of Mount Ogura,
If they could understand,
Would keep their brilliant leaves, until
The Ruler of this land
Pass with his royal band.
